instruction: Count how many orders have sales greater than 500 using COUNTIF and put the result in cell A30.

metadata.capability_extraction: Can open LibreOffice Calc, navigate cells, select cells, type text values into cells
metadata.failure_analysis: Model selected wrong column (A instead of B for 'Seq No.'), started from row 1 instead of row 2 (overwriting header area), and could not complete the repetitive task of filling 28 cells within the time limit.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single-cell COUNTIF formula task, requiring navigating to one cell and typing one formula with a condition. Tests the model's ability to use conditional counting, within its demonstrated capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires entering a COUNTIF formula in A30 to count Sales values > 500 (from E2:E29). Getter reads A30 value with data_only=True. Expected value is 12.0 (12 orders with sales > 500).

Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': accesses expected.get('expected_value') directly from the rules dict, which is the correct pattern.
Postconfig properly activates the window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before reading, ensuring cached computed values are written to the xlsx file.
